description: This Kotlin source file defines an in-memory fallback implementation of a Room database, along with DAO implementations, for use when a real SQLite database is unavailable. It provides in-memory data storage and management for profiles, connections, and transfer history, suitable for testing or fallback scenarios.

classes.name: InMemoryAppDatabase
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of the Room AppDatabase used as a fallback when the real database is unavailable. It provides DAO methods backed by in-memory state flows.

classes.name: InMemoryConnectionDao
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of the ConnectionDao interface, managing ConnectionEntity objects with in-memory state.

classes.name: InMemoryTransferHistoryDao
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of the TransferHistoryDao interface, managing TransferHistoryEntity objects with in-memory state.

methods.name: profileDao
methods.description: Returns the ProfileDao implementation.

methods.name: connectionDao
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionDao implementation.

methods.name: transferHistoryDao
methods.description: Returns the TransferHistoryDao implementation.

methods.name: createInvalidationTracker
methods.description: Creates a no-op InvalidationTracker for in-memory fallback.

methods.name: createOpenHelper
methods.description: Returns a no-op SupportSQLiteOpenHelper suitable for in-memory operation.

methods.name: clearAllTables
methods.description: Clears all in-memory tables (profiles, connections, transfer history).

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all ConnectionEntity objects, ordered by descending id.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConnectionEntity by its id.

methods.name: findByAlias
methods.description: Finds a ConnectionEntity by its alias.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new ConnectionEntity, assigning a unique id if necessary.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing ConnectionEntity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific ConnectionEntity.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a ConnectionEntity by its id.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all in-memory connection data and resets the id counter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all TransferHistoryEntity objects, ordered by most recent start time.

methods.name: getByConnectionId
methods.description: Retrieves transfer history entries for a specific connection id.

methods.name: getRecent
methods.description: Retrieves a limited number of recent transfer history entries.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a transfer history entry by its id.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new TransferHistoryEntity, assigning a unique id if necessary.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing TransferHistoryEntity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific TransferHistoryEntity.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a transfer history entry by its id.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all in-memory transfer history data and resets the id counter.
